title: Hingehealth Metric2 High Value Outliers
dataSources: MedBridge exercises (`medbridge:exercise`), PT clinic sessions (`pt:session`), Hinge Health sessions (`hingehealth:session`), rehab range-of-motion logs (`rehab:rom`), and pain diary entries (`pain:diary`).
app: MedBridge exercise completions, clinic PT session exports, Hinge Health digital sessions, ROM measurement logs, and pain diary entries forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hingehealth:metric2 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in hingehealth metric2 (2) events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme hingehealth metric2 (2) records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It rates the unusually high or low value moments in your hingehealth metric2 (2) history.
